title: Multi-Tier Edge Triage: Optimizing Latency for Safe Clinical Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.26914v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deploying generative AI agents in enterprise clinical workflows requires enforcing multi-dimensional safety and compliance policies--preventing HIPAA Protected Health Information (PHI) exposure, maintaining clinical scope-of-practice boundaries, ensuring patient-appropriate reading comprehension, and preserving brand integrity--under interactive latency constraints. Synchronous outbound calls to cloud Large Language Model (LLM) judges add substantial network and decoding overhead onto the critical response path. We present Multi-Tier Edge Triage, a safety screening architecture that co-locates a compact Tier-1 sequence classifier on the clinical agent's host server, resolving clear queries in-process without a network round-trip and escalating only ambiguous queries to a Tier-2 cloud LLM judge. To evaluate Tier-1 encoders without length or unigram shortcuts, we construct four length-matched contrastive twin benchmarks seeded from MedSafe

translated_title: 多层级边缘分诊：为安全的临床智能体优化延迟
translated_abstract: 在企业临床工作流程中部署生成式AI智能体，需要在交互式延迟约束下执行多维度的安全与合规政策——包括防止HIPAA受保护健康信息（PHI）泄露、维持临床执业范围边界、确保面向患者阅读理解水平的适配性，以及维护品牌完整性。对云端大语言模型（LLM）评审器的同步外呼会在关键响应路径上增加大量网络与解码开销。我们提出了多层级边缘分诊，这是一种安全筛查架构，它在临床智能体的宿主服务器上共同部署一个紧凑的第一层序列分类器，从而在进程内直接处理明确的查询而无需网络往返，并仅将模糊的查询升级至第二层云端LLM评审器。为了在没有长度或一元词捷径的情况下评估第一层编码器，我们基于MedSafe构建了四个长度匹配的对比孪生基准。
tldr: 该论文提出多层级边缘分诊安全筛查架构，通过在临床智能体宿主服务器本地部署轻量级第一层分类器以进程内处理明确查询、仅将模糊查询升级至云端LLM评审器，在保障多维安全合规的同时显著降低响应延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Multi-Tier Edge Triage, a safety screening architecture that co-locates a compact Tier-1 classifier on the clinical agent's host server to resolve clear queries in-process and escalate only ambiguous ones to a cloud LLM judge, substantially reducing latency while enforcing multi-dimensional safety and compliance policies.
